name: domino-tiling
description: Count and render every domino tiling of a 2n×2n board (OEIS A004003): bitmask dynamic programming solvers (Number and BigInt), an exact closed-form formula solver, an unranking renderer and an online gallery.

scripts.benchmark: node benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -m 7 && node benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-Formula.js && node benchmarkRunner.js -n 10 -m 2 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js && node benchmarkRunner.js -n 1 -o 9 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js
